# City of San Diego Official Website

> San Diego's comprehensive municipal portal providing access to parks, recreation, leisure activities, utilities, and civic services for residents and visitors.

sandiego.gov serves as the official government website for the City of San Diego, offering integrated access to parks and recreation facilities (including iconic destinations like Balboa Park and Mission Bay), leisure activities, municipal services, and resident resources. The site uses tools like SDRecConnect for activity registration and ArcGIS for geographic information.

## Key Topics

- Balboa Park
- Mission Bay Park
- Regional Parks
- San Diego Beaches
- Public Pools
- Municipal Golf Courses
- Recreation Centers
- Park Permits
- Leisure Activities
- Utility Payments
- Trash & Recycling Collection
- Street Maintenance
- Special Events & Filming
- Cultural Affairs
- Resident Resources

## Parks & Recreation

- [Leisure](https://www.sandiego.gov/leisure): Central hub for San Diego leisure activities, parks, beaches, and attractions.
- [Developed Regional Parks](https://www.sandiego.gov/park-and-recreation/parks/regional): Directory of San Diego regional parks including Balboa Park and Mission Bay Park.
- [Balboa Park](https://www.sandiego.gov/park-and-recreation/parks/regional/balboa): Balboa Park overview with museums, gardens, and cultural institutions.
- [Recreation Centers and Pools](https://www.sandiego.gov/park-and-recreation/centers): Guide to recreation centers, pools, and activity registration via SDRecConnect.
- [Pools](https://www.sandiego.gov/pools): Public pool locations, schedules, and admission information.
- [Park Use Permits and Applications](https://www.sandiego.gov/park-and-recreation/parks/permits): Park use permit applications and requirements for Balboa Park and other venues.

## Beaches, Water Activities & Golf

- [Beaches and Bays](https://www.sandiego.gov/leisure/beaches-and-bays): Information on San Diego beaches, Mission Bay, and water activities.
- [Golf Courses](https://www.sandiego.gov/park-and-recreation/golf): Municipal golf courses with tee-time reservations and resident discounts.
- [Torrey Pines Golf Course](https://www.sandiego.gov/park-and-recreation/golf/torreypines): Torrey Pines Golf Course tee times, fees, and tournament information.

## Resident Services & Utilities

- [Resident Resources](https://www.sandiego.gov/resident-resources): Central resource hub for resident services, permits, and community needs.
- [Pay Your Bill](https://www.sandiego.gov/public-utilities/customer-support/pay-your-bill): Utility bill payment options and customer support for water services.
- [Collection Schedules](https://www.sandiego.gov/environmental-services/collection/schedule): Trash, recycling, and organic waste collection schedules.

## Street Maintenance & Infrastructure

- [Street Resurfacing and Pothole Repair](https://www.sandiego.gov/street-div/services/street-resurfacing-pothole-repair): Street resurfacing and pothole repair programs and maintenance information.
- [Street Sweeping](https://www.sandiego.gov/streetsweeping): Street sweeping schedules and stormwater pollution prevention.
- [Streetlights](https://www.sandiego.gov/street-div/services/electrical/strlight): Streetlight maintenance and lighting infrastructure services.

## Planning, Events & Cultural Affairs

- [Special Events & Filming](https://www.sandiego.gov/specialevents-filming): Special events and filming permits and applications for San Diego.
- [General Plan & Community Plans](https://www.sandiego.gov/planning/community-plans): General Plan and community development plans for San Diego neighborhoods.
- [Cultural Affairs](https://www.sandiego.gov/economic-development/cultural-affairs): Cultural affairs programs, artist funding, and San Diego Poet Laureate.

## Main Portal

- [City of San Diego Official Website](https://www.sandiego.gov): Official City of San Diego portal with government services, permits, and civic engagement.
